headline: Second straight rally: KSE-100 closed UP 1,841.39pts (+1.09%) at 170,884.58 on Fri Sep 18 as Brent slid a third straight day to ~$103.5 on easing Middle-East supply worries. Drawdown from the Jan 23 ATH (189,556) has narrowed to ~9.9% — just back UNDER the 10% dry-powder line (still far from the 15% heavier-shift line). Portfolio ~Rs 10.18M incl. cash, P/L ~-Rs 77,000 (~-0.75% on cost) — up from ~-1.74% two sessions ago. No holding moved >5% (AIRLINK +4.4% largest). Watch item next week: IMF review mission arrives ~Sep 23. AVN's EXIT call and the AICF/MICF redeployment both remain unexecuted — index.html holdings unchanged.
market: KSE-100: Fri Sep 18 closed at 170,884.58, UP 1,841.39pts (+1.09%), crossing back above 170,000, helped by a third consecutive daily decline in crude (Brent ~-1.3% to ~$103.5/bbl) as immediate supply concerns eased and traders focused on US-Iran diplomacy; Wall Street's relief rally carried into Asia after a volatile week for central banks (Fed hiked 25bps to 3.75-4% on Sep 17; SBP held at 11.5% on Sep 14). The over-six-month Middle-East war still shows few signs of ending, keeping oil above $100. Next week: an IMF mission is expected in Pakistan from ~Sep 23 for the review of the USD 7bn EFF and USD 1.4bn RSF (staying to early October) — a mild event risk for the market and PKR (USD/PKR ~278, stable). AVN: no new news since the Sep 2 H1 FY26 loss filing (an Aug USD 6.3M fuel-retail automation order is already known); EXIT unchanged. EFERT: no new results/dividend news (last payment Sep 3, ex-date Aug 10); urea-glut WATCH unchanged. DRAP pharma pricing: still unresolved — govt directed an urgent review of the formula/Hardship Policy (Aug 28), industry opposing, nothing enacted; GLAXO/SEARL stance unchanged. No new ex-dividend dates confirmed for any holding in this review's searches. DATA QUALITY: stock prices from prices.json updated 2026-09-18T19:06Z (final Friday snapshot, current). Review run on Saturday Sep 19 (market closed). Fund NAVs still frozen at Aug 13 — now 37 days stale; the MUFAP scraper still needs a direct fix.

entries.basis: Monthly-timeframe accumulation zones for a 10-25yr horizon: where fundamentals + monthly support align to add in small portions. 'entry' = start nibbling at/below; 'add' = deeper monthly support to load more. Pakistan macro-aware (SBP 11.5%, KSE-100 off the Jan ATH). These are accumulation guides, not precise buy/sell signals — verify with your broker.

MZNPETF.note: Broad Islamic index ETF — your #1 DCA vehicle. Accumulate on any dip; entry is just under fair value, add = deeper monthly support.

MIIETF.note: Second index-ETF leg. Same DCA logic — buy small and often, more at the add level.
